sections.heading: Institution Overview
paragraphs:
Full Name: Shree Devi Institute of Technology
Short Name: SDIT
Aliases:
  - Shree Devi Institute of Technology Kenjar
  - Shridevi Institute of Technology
  - Shree Devi Engineering College
Type: Private, self-financing engineering & management institute
Established Year: 2006
Aicte Recognition Year: 2006
Run By: Shree Devi Education Trust (R.)
Trust Established Year: 1992
Affiliating University: Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi (Belgaum), Karnataka
Recognized By: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi
Accreditation:
  Naac: NAAC accreditation process undergone (Self Study Report / SSR submitted and criteria-wise documentation published on the official NAAC page); specific letter grade/CGPA is not published on the official website pages reviewed - verify current grade with the college or NAAC's website.
  Notable Award: Conferred 'Excellent Engineering College in Karnataka' award (per official/press communications).
Campus Area: Approx. 12 acres, set in Kenjar village amidst suburban Mangalore
Tagline Description: A premier institution in Kenjar, Mangalore offering Engineering (BE, M.Tech), Management (MBA), Computer Applications (MCA) and Research (PhD) programs, affiliated to VTU and recognized by AICTE.
Website: https://sdit.ac.in
Trust Website: https://sdc.ac.in
Social Media:
  Note: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram icons are present in the site footer/header, but the official site's icon links were not resolvable to specific handles at the time of collection; verify current handles via the official website footer.

sections.heading: Vision And Mission
paragraphs:
Vision: To be an institution of academic excellence imparting technical and management education integrated with human values to face the social and environmental challenges.
Mission:
  - Disseminate quality education with student centric-learning methodologies.
  - Actively engage and encourage students, faculty and staff.
  - Mentoring students and provide career development support.
  - Impart education that transforms students and empower them to emerge as professionals by inculcating entrepreneurial attitudes with social and ethical values.

sections.heading: Governing Trust
paragraphs:
Name: Shree Devi Education Trust (R.)
Established Year: 1992
Description: Founded by a team of educationalists to provide quality professional education; runs multiple colleges in Mangalore across Engineering, Management, Health Sciences, Fashion Design, Hospitality and more.
Sister Institutions:
  - Shree Devi Institute of Technology (B.E., M.Tech, MBA, MCA)
  - Shree Devi College of Pharmacy (B.Pharm, M.Pharm, Pharm D)
  - Shree Devi College of Physiotherapy (BPT, MPT)
  - Shree Devi College of Nursing (B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing)
  - Shree Devi School of Nursing (GNM)
  - Shree Devi College of Hotel Management (BHS Hotel Management; BHS Aviation & Hospitality Management; B.Sc Food, Nutrition & Dietetics; B.Sc Food Technology)
  - Shree Devi College of Fashion Design (B.Sc FD)
  - Shree Devi College of Interior Design (B.Sc ID&D)
  - Shree Devi College of Information Science (BCA; BCA Aviation & Hospitality Management; BCA AI, Big Data Analytics & Cyber Security)
  - Shree Devi Institute of Social Work (BSW, MSW)
  - Shree Devi College (BBA/B.Com - Aviation & Hospitality Mgmt; BBA/B.Com - Logistics & Supply Chain Mgmt; BBA/B.Com - AI, Big Data & Cyber Security; B.Com; BBA)
  - Shree Devi College of Allied Health Sciences (B.Sc MLT, MIT, Anaesthesia & OTT, Respiratory Care Tech, Renal Dialysis Tech)

sections.heading: Academic Programs
paragraphs:
Undergraduate Be:
  Program: Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Department Established: 2006
  Overview: Instituted in 2006 owing to rising demand for computer professionals; encourages sponsored research through industry-institute collaboration; state-of-the-art facilities.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Data Structure Lab
    - OOPS Lab
    - Electronics Circuits & Logic Design Lab
    - Microprocessor Lab
    - Operating Systems Lab
    - Computer Networking Lab
    - Algorithms Lab
    - DBMS Lab
    - System Programming Lab
    - Internet Programming Lab
  Program: Information Science & Engineering (ISE)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Focuses on Internet & Communication Technologies (ICT), data-intensive applications, e-business/e-commerce/e-learning/e-governance paradigms; VTU syllabus revised to align with industry.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Data Structure Lab
    - OOPS Lab
    - Electronics Circuits & Logic Design Lab
    - Microprocessor Lab
    - Operating Systems Lab
    - Computer Networking Lab
    - Algorithms Lab
    - DBMS Lab
    - System Programming Lab
    - Internet Programming Lab
  Program: Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) - CSE (AI&ML)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Instituted owing to increasing demand for computer professionals; encourages sponsored research through industry-institute collaboration.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Data Structure Lab
    - OOPS Lab
    - Electronics Circuits & Logic Design Lab
    - Microprocessor Lab
    - Operating Systems Lab
    - Computer Networking Lab
    - Algorithms Lab
    - DBMS Lab
    - System Programming Lab
    - Internet Programming Lab
  Program: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI&DS)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Instituted owing to increasing demand for computer professionals and software developers; state-of-the-art facilities for students.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Data Structure Lab
    - OOPS Lab
    - Electronics Circuits & Logic Design Lab
    - Microprocessor Lab
    - Operating Systems Lab
    - Computer Networking Lab
    - Algorithms Lab
    - DBMS Lab
    - System Programming Lab
    - Internet Programming Lab
  Program: Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Imparts quality education for openings in Telecommunication and Computer industries; deepens knowledge in analysis, systems implementation, operation, production and maintenance of electronics/communication applications.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Analog Electronics Lab
    - Logic Design Lab
    - HDL Lab
    - Microcontrollers Lab
    - DSP Lab
    - Analog Communication Lab + LIC Lab
    - Advance Communication Lab
    - Microprocessor Lab
    - VLSI Lab
    - Power Electronics Lab
  Program: Mechanical Engineering (ME)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Applies physics & materials science principles for analysis, design, manufacturing and maintenance of mechanical systems; backed by CAED and CAMD labs.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Metallographic & Material Testing Lab
    - Mechanical Measurement Lab I & II
    - Foundry & Forging Lab I & II
    - Energy Conservation Lab
    - Computer Aided Modeling & Analysis Lab
    - CIM & Automation Lab
    - Design Lab
    - Heat & Mass Transfer Lab
    - Machine Shop I & II
    - Metrology & Instrumentation Lab
    - Fluid Mechanics Lab
  Program: Civil Engineering (CE)
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Emphasis on quality education addressing growing economy/population needs for scientifically designed sustainable physical spaces; broad grounding in scientific principles and materials.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Basic Material Testing Lab
    - Surveying Practice Lab I & II
    - Applied Engineering Geology Lab
    - Hydraulic Lab / F.M Lab
    - CAD Lab
    - Concrete & Highway Materials Testing Lab
    - Environment Engineering Lab
    - Geo-Tech Lab
  Program: Aeronautical Engineering
  Degree: B.E.
  Duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  Overview: Covers aircraft design, stability & control of aerospace vehicles, propulsion systems, low/high speed aerodynamics, and advanced defense/space technologies; adopts Project Based Learning.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Metallographic & Material Testing / Mechanical Measurement Lab I & II
    - Foundry & Forging Lab I & II
    - Energy Conservation Lab
    - Computer Aided Modeling & Analysis Lab
    - CIM & Automation Lab
    - Design Lab
    - Heat & Mass Transfer Lab
    - Machine Shop I & II
    - Metrology & Instrumentation Lab
    - Fluid Mechanics Lab
Postgraduate:
  Program: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
  Degree: MBA
  Duration: 2 years
  Overview: Stresses managerial aspects of accounting, finance, marketing and management; case studies and industrial visits prepare students for managerial roles in small businesses and MNCs.
  Vision: To impart management education instilling human values that transform lives and careers.
  Notable Recruiters Context: Industrial visits to prominent companies; MBA fest 'Echelon'; student clubs under umbrella association 'Meraki' (HRiday - HR Club, Mantra - Marketing Club, Artha - Finance Club).
  Pgcet Code: B281
  Program: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
  Degree: MCA
  Duration: 2 years full-time (4 semesters, incl. internship in Sem IV)
  Overview: Equips students with advanced knowledge in computer science, programming and software development; interactive classes, national seminars, outbound activities, projects and internships.
  Vision: Empowering students to become skilled professionals and leaders in the dynamic field of technology fostering teamwork and ethical practices.
  Semester Structure:
    Sem 1:
      - Programming and Problem-Solving in C
      - Discrete Mathematics and Graph Theory
      - Database Management Systems (DBMS)
      - Operating System
      - Web Technologies
      - DBMS and Web Technologies Laboratory
      - Research Methodology and IPR
    Sem 2:
      - Machine Learning and Data Analytics using Python
      - Object Oriented Programming using JAVA
      - Data Structure and Algorithms
      - Software Engineering
      - Web Application Development
      - OOP using JAVA Laboratory
      - Data Structure and Algorithms Laboratory
    Sem 3:
      - Specialization subjects with Project Work
    Sem 4:
      - Internship
  Student Association: SPARKLE (student-driven technical/innovation association); NIRVAN (Alumni Association); annual national-level tech fest 'Medha'
  Pgcet Code: C476
Mtech:
  Program: M.Tech - Construction Technology
  Degree: M.Tech
  Overview: Prepares civil engineers for real-estate/construction boom, consultancy, quality testing labs, road projects, research and teaching; also covers business, communication and management knowledge for construction management.
  Lab Facilities:
    - Basic Material Testing Lab
    - Surveying Practice Lab I & II
    - Applied Engineering Geology Lab
    - Hydraulic Lab / F.M Lab
    - Concrete & Highway Materials Testing Lab
    - Environment Engineering Lab
    - Geo-Tech Lab
  Pgcet Code: T868
Doctoral:
  Program: Research Centre (PhD)
  Overview: Established to facilitate research and knowledge generation; the Physics Research Centre facilitates a doctoral program with active national and international research collaborations.
  Eligibility And Subjects: Not yet published on the official website ('will be updated soon') - contact the institute directly for current PhD eligibility, entrance test and subject/guide availability.

pages.title: Admissions
pages.meta_description: Structured SDIT institutional knowledge base section.

sections.heading: Admissions
paragraphs:
Entrance Exams Accepted:
  - KCET (Karnataka Common Entrance Test) - for BE
  - COMEDK UGET - for BE
  - Karnataka PGCET - for MBA/MCA/M.Tech
  - Valid GATE score - alternative route for M.Tech
Eligibility:
  Be Bachelor Of Engineering:
    Criteria: Pass in Pre-University Board (PUC) or any equivalent examination recognized by the University, with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics.
    Relaxation: 40% aggregate for SC/ST and OBC category students.
    Documents Required:
      - Original Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC)
      - Original Pre-University Certificate (PUC)
      - Photocopy of Aadhaar card
      - Original Transfer Certificate (TC) and Conduct Certificate
      - Passport size photo of applicant
      - Migration certificate (for non-Karnataka students)
  Mba:
    Criteria: Pass in a Bachelor's Degree (minimum 3-year duration) from a recognized University with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks across all subjects/years, including languages.
    Relaxation: 45% for SC/ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates; reservation/concession applicable only to Karnataka candidates.
  Mca:
    Criteria: Pass in BCA / B.E. in Computer Science / equivalent degree, OR B.Sc/B.Com/B.A (preferably with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level; bridge courses required if no Maths background), with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks across all subjects/years.
    Relaxation: 45% for SC/ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates.
    Documents Required:
      - Original Undergraduate Certificate and/or provisional course clearance certificate
      - Original Undergraduate degree marks cards
      - Original SSLC
      - Original PUC
      - Photocopy of Aadhaar card
      - Original TC and Conduct Certificate
      - Passport size photo

pages.meta_description: Structured SDIT institutional knowledge base section.

sections.heading: Placements
paragraphs:
Overview: Placements begin from the seventh semester; students take part in on-campus and pool-campus interviews across the Mangalore region. SDIT reports having placed all eligible, interested candidates across Engineering, MBA and MCA in recent years.
Historical Offer Letters:
  2016: 427+
  2017: 452+
  2018: 461+
  2019: 480+
  2020: 492+
Recent Placement Rate Claim: On average 90-95% of eligible final-year students placed through campus placements (per official site, referring to the preceding 3 years at time of writing).
Placement Cell Facilities:
  - Seminar hall for company presentations
  - Group discussion rooms
  - Conferencing facilities
  - Interview and discussion rooms
Placement Cell Objectives:
  - Assist development of graduates with balanced technical and interpersonal skills and a positive attitude.
  - Act as a nodal agency forging technology alliances between departments and industries.
  - Provide quality technical manpower suited to organizational needs.
